fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responding units can confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the driveway entry clearly on both sides to help crews identify the single access point quickly during low-visibility conditions.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway to maintain clear passage width for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the main residence to keep it from blocking ground-level movement around the structure.
• Clear a walking path around the perimeter of the main residence so responders can move between the front and rear without pushing through vegetation.
• Trim dense vegetation adjacent to the detached structure to allow responders to reach and work around it without obstruction.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear of debris and overgrowth so responders can move between the two structures quickly.
• Identify and mark any rear access point, even if limited, so responders are not caught off-guard by a dead end during an active incident.
• Keep a gate, path, or opening at the rear of the property unlocked and passable so responders have an alternative exit if the front driveway becomes blocked.
• Stage a visible property map or site diagram near the driveway entrance showing the location of the main residence, detached structure, patio, and access paths so arriving units can orient quickly.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or touch the house.
• Thin the tree clusters closest to the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants growing directly against the sides of the house.
• Separate the dense vegetation surrounding the structure by cutting back plants to create open space between them and the walls.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so their branches do not touch or connect with each other.
• Clear shrubs, low branches, and tall grass growing along both sides of the driveway.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway so vehicles, including fire trucks, can pass through without obstruction.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from within the tree clusters near the structure.
• Cut back vegetation in the tree clusters to break up continuous canopy coverage leading toward the house.
• Keep the open green space areas mowed and free of accumulated dead plant material.
• Maintain clear ground beneath large trees by removing low branches and shrubs growing underneath them.
